questions.question: How do raceways differ from ponds?
questions.solution_html:
• Raceways differ from ponds in that raceways are long, narrow tanks with a
  • continuous flow of water, which provides better oxygen supply and waste removal for
  • fish. Ponds are larger, still water bodies where water exchange is limited and fish are
  • cultured in a more natural environment.
questions.final_answer: cultured in a more natural environment
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: What is the role of climate in aquaculture facility planning?
questions.solution_html:
• Climate plays an important role in aquaculture facility planning because factors such
  • as temperature, rainfall, wind and sunlight affect water quality and fish growth.
  • Proper understanding of climate helps in selecting suitable sites, designing ponds and
  • ensuring healthy fish production throughout the year.
questions.final_answer: ensuring healthy fish production throughout the year
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Why should harvested aquatic organisms be handled gently?
questions.solution_html:
• Harvested aquatic organisms should be handled gently to avoid physical damage to
  • their body such as bruising, scale loss or injury. Gentle handling also reduces stress
  • and helps maintain the freshness, quality and market value of the harvested organisms.
questions.final_answer: and helps maintain the freshness, quality and market value of the harvested organisms
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Why is carbohydrate important in fish diets?
questions.solution_html:
• Carbohydrates are important in fish diets because they provide a cheap and easily
  • available source of energy for fish. They help spare proteins for growth and also
  • improve the utilization of other nutrients in the feed.
questions.final_answer: improve the utilization of other nutrients in the feed
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Mention any two reasons for occurrnce of diseases in aquatic / organisms.
questions.solution_html:
• Mention any two reasons for concurrence of diseases in aquatic organisms.
  • Diseases in aquatic organisms occur due to poor water quality and overcrowding in
  • culture systems. They may also be caused by pathogens such as bacteria, viruses
  • parasites and fungi which infect weakened or stressed organisms.
questions.final_answer: parasites and fungi which infect weakened or stressed organisms
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: What is meant by sustainable aquaculture?
questions.solution_html:
• Sustainable aquaculture means the farming of aquatic organisms in a way that meets
  • present needs without damaging the environment or depleting natural resources. It
  • ensures long-term production while maintaining ecological balance and protecting
  • aquatic ecosystems.
questions.final_answer: aquatic ecosystems
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: What are the common methods used for eradication of weed fishes?
questions.solution_html:
• Common methods used for eradication of weed fishes include draining and drying of
  • ponds and the use of fish toxicants such as mahua oil cake or rotenone. These
  • methods help eliminate unwanted fishes before stocking cultured species.
questions.final_answer: methods help eliminate unwanted fishes before stocking cultured species
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Why is availability of seed important in species selection for / aquaculture?
questions.solution_html:
• Availability of seed is important in species selection for aquaculture because a regular
  • and reliable supply of healthy seed ensures successful stocking and continuous
  • production. Lack of good quality seed can affect growth, survival and overall
  • productivity of the culture system.
questions.final_answer: productivity of the culture system
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: How soil filling is done during construction of dike?
questions.solution_html:
• Soil filling during construction of a dike is done by placing soil in layers and
  • compacting each layer properly to make the structure strong and stable. This method
  • helps prevent erosion, leakage and damage to the dike.
questions.final_answer: helps prevent erosion, leakage and damage to the dike
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: What precautions are taken during fish pond preparation? Write any two / factors
questions.solution_html:
• During fish pond preparation precautions are taken such as removing weeds and
  • unwanted fishes, drying and cleaning the pond bottom, repairing pond dikes and
  • ensuring proper inlet and outlet structures. Liming and fertilization are also done to
  • improve soil and water quality before stocking fish. (any two points)
questions.final_answer: improve soil and water quality before stocking fish. (any two points)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: How does value addition improve consumer acceptance?
questions.solution_html:
• Value addition improves consumer acceptance by enhancing the quality, taste

questions.question: Describe the common types of aquatic insects found in aquaculture / ponds.
questions.solution_html:
• Common aquatic insects in aquaculture ponds include water beetles, water bugs
  • dragonfly and damselfly larvae, and mosquito larvae, Some insects act as predators of
  • fish eggs and larvae, Others serve as natural food for fish, They influence the
  • ecological balance of pond ecosystem, High abundance of predatory insects can
  • reduce fish seed survival, Regular monitoring and control are important for healthy
  • fish culture.
questions.final_answer: fish culture
